text:
charlie: quick report — walked a new teammate through the web quickstart after SSO invite. first call returns 403 and the app just shows 'Request failed (403)'.

charlie: chrome console shows `{"error":"workspace_billing_required","message":"billing required to enable hosted endpoints"}` but nothing clickable in the UI.

bot-onboard: Hi @charlie — new workspaces require a billing method before hosted inference is enabled. Add one here: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/abc987/billing :credit_card:

meera: thanks. short-term workaround is to run the quickstart with a service API key (export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_...) so it bypasses workspace gating during local dev.

meera: long-term fix proposal: quickstart client should map that error code -> persistent banner/modal that includes the billing console link and a short note about SSO-invite timing.

charlie: agreed. also can we emit an `x-redwood-why: billing_required` header so non-JS clients can more easily detect this?

meera: yep I'll open a tiny PR in starter-stub and an infra ticket for the header + telemetry event `onboard_missing_billing`.

charlie: will add a one-line note in the onboarding README about accepting invites before billing attach. leaving this open until PR lands and QA passes.
